name: Katahdin via the Knife Edge (Pamola to Baxter Peak)

legs.route: Helon Taylor Trail from Roaring Brook

legs.connect: Cross the narrow granite ridge over Chimney Peak and South Peak, with a hands-on downclimb into the Chimney notch.

how: A loop that climbs the open ridge to Pamola, crosses the Knife Edge to the state high point, then comes down a gentler trail. The ridge is sustained scrambling with continuous exposure and no rails; the notch is the hardest move and retreating after it is difficult. Wind, wet rock, ice or cloud make it unsafe, and the sides are no escape.
descent: From Baxter Peak, descend by the Saddle Trail to the basin lake, then the approach trail back to the campground. The steep Cathedral Trail is not advised as a descent.
logistics: Day use needs a reserved parking pass; camping is booked separately. Lots fill and a morning gate cutoff applies. Parties are limited in size, no dogs, no water on the ridge. Hamlin Peak is a separate optional add-on.
notes: Ridge length 1.1 miles, loop 9 to 10 miles with about 4,000 ft gain per one source. The Hamlin leg was not confirmed by either page so is omitted. Class is a hiker's scramble, not roped climbing.
